By submitting your information you agree to the Terms & Conditions and Privacy Policy and are aged 16 or over. # What to Look Out for in Economic Data This Week (June 8-12). Inflation will be top of mind this week, with the May CPI and PPI among the economic reports scheduled for release. Inflation will be the main focus of the economic calendar, with updates on consumer and wholesale prices due out. **Wednesday, June 10: Consumer Price Index (CPI) and core CPI:** Economists expect the May CPI report to show that higher energy prices continue to lift inflation. Profit and prosper with the best of expert advice on investing, taxes, retirement, personal finance and more - straight to your e-mail. **Friday, June 11: University of Michigan's Consumer Sentiment Index:** Inflation continues to be a top concern for consumers. | **8:30 am** | **Consumer Price Index (CPI)** | **May** |.
